title: ECoG_HB_02: hybrid-density ECoG high-gamma features with synchronised speech, one participant (derivative)
description: This derivative dataset repackages the publicly released single-participant ECoG_HB_02 recording from Chen et al. (2024). It contains hybrid-density ECoG high-gamma (70-150 Hz) envelope features at 125 Hz, z-scored per electrode, with synchronised speech audio and word-trial events. The raw voltage recordings were not released, and the data support research on neural speech decoding.
methods_description: In the source study, ECoG was sampled at 2,048 Hz and downsampled to 512 Hz. Artefactual and epileptiform electrodes were rejected and a common average reference was applied. The Hilbert envelope of the 70-150 Hz high-gamma band was downsampled to 125 Hz and z-scored to pre-stimulus silent baselines. This derivative stores the feature matrix as BrainVision float32, marks all-zero columns as bad, and adds word-trial events. The original HB02.h5 file is kept unchanged in sourcedata.
